output.summary: Fast-growing, drought-resistant tree native to northern India. It has feathery foliage and hanging three-sided pods, and its young pods and leaves are widely cultivated as vegetables, although Australia prohibits their retail food use because safety evidence was insufficient.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves, immature pods, seeds, flowers, roots and seed oil are used as food; excess root compounds may harm, and Australia prohibits retail food use.
